Daily JSON data by environment, user, agent and feature powers dashboards, FinOps reporting and automated cost controls.

Makers can customize these forms while preserving their connection to SharePoint list actions. Existing customized forms retain their current layouts.

signals.title: Power Apps: Browse data with automatic loading and numbered pages in Data Grid

signals.title: Power Automate: Desktop flow libraries
